checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'on-page-optimization'.

checks.description: Each page spec serves exactly one clear search intent.
checks.rule: Each on_page_spec assigns the page a single primary_query and one intent; multi-intent pages are split or focused.

checks.description: Each spec carries title, meta, headings, internal links, and schema.
checks.rule: Every on_page_spec includes url, primary_query, title, meta, headings, internal_links, and schema.

checks.description: Title and meta are produced in Arabic and English with correct RTL.
checks.rule: Title and meta exist in ar and en, Arabic-first, with RTL noted so direction does not break.

checks.description: Schema markup carries no invented claims or unconfirmed titles.
checks.rule: Schema fields reference only values traceable to the brief; no invented Skill Path titles, instructor names, or accreditation claims.

checks.description: A page serving generative intent is structured to be cited by answer engines.
checks.rule: When the page serves generative (answer-engine) intent, it leads with a clear definitional or direct answer, uses FAQ schema and question-led headings, and keeps claims self-contained for accurate quotation.

checks.description: No on-page element implies certificate accreditation.
checks.rule: No title, meta, heading, or schema field states or implies certificates are accredited.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name in any field.
checks.rule: Titles, metas, and schema reference only offers and titles traceable to the brief; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask.
